field.name: reminder_threshold_days
field.help: Business days (per the company resource calendar) before the first reminder fires.

field.name: escalation_threshold_days
field.help: Business days before the approval is escalated to the backup approver. Must exceed the reminder threshold.

field.name: backup_approver_id
field.help: Who receives the escalation. Falls back to the original approver's manager, then the final fallback recipient, when unset.

field.name: fallback_admin_id
field.help: Last-resort recipient when no backup approver exists and the original approver has no manager.
